_instructions: Copy under recipes.facebook/reddit/nextdoor/craigslist/offerup in the HOST-LOCAL config. Capture exact locators with the Playwright inspector. These example locators are NOT calibrated platform selectors. Run validate on an existing public post before enabling live mode.
_verifyAs: Optional. "public" (the default) reads the post back in a fresh, signed-out browser context. "author" reads it back in this publisher's own signed-in session: required for Nextdoor unless you provide readerStorageState for a second account, and weaker, because it proves the post exists with this text and author, not who else can see it.

_renew_example._comment: Listings only. Rename this key to "renew" once calibrated. startUrl is the page the renewal starts from (for Craigslist, the account's page for this listing); without it the runner opens the listing's own permalink. confirmLocator is the element that appears once the renewal succeeded; without it the runner waits for the permalink, or reads permalinkLocator.
